name: Super Dope Prepackaged Flower | Cherry Popperz Minis
description:
Genetics: Gelato 41 x Zkittkez 

Indica-dominant hybrid

Cherry Popperz by Super Dope has an aroma of deep sweet musky cherries. Earthy cherry notes on the inhale, while in contrast on the exhale is creamy citrus lemon notes with a lingering muskiness. The high is an immaculately clean head and body high.
